segments.name: Logistics services
segments.description: Provides freight forwarding, supply chain management and other value-added services to its customers, including manufacturers.
segments.evidence: there is only one reportable operating segment since all types of the services provided and products delivered are viewed as an integrated business process

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for freight forwarding, supply chain management and other value-added services.
revenueModel.evidence: affect demand for supply chain solutions and logistics services, in China and globally.

changes.text: Starting in 2024, the Group operated and reviewed its performance in PRC and Hong Kong and U.S.A. segments after acquiring interests in US companies.
